context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested 3 new features: (1) Live Subtitles - toggle-subtitles-button with Captions icon in MeetingControls, uses Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition) which cannot be tested in headless browser, subtitle overlay appears at bottom when subtitleText is set. (2) Whiteboard Shapes - Rectangle (wb-tool-rect), Circle (wb-tool-circle), Arrow (wb-tool-arrow) tools added to toolbar, shapes drawn via click-drag on canvas, strokes persisted via whiteboard-stroke-complete WebSocket message. (3) Sticky Notes - Note tool (wb-tool-note), click canvas to create note, notes have drag handle, delete button, and editable textarea, notes synced via whiteboard-note/whiteboard-note-complete/whiteboard-note-delete WebSocket messages, notes persisted in whiteboard_notes collection, GET /whiteboard/notes returns persisted notes, DELETE /whiteboard clears both strokes AND notes.
